items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: He worked for Benny Goodman for four years, in '36 until '40.

ctx.x: Married before '36. I'll tell you that. He worked for Benny Goodman for four years, in '36 until '40. He was on that Camel Caravan, as you remember.
Well, he was telling me that they got married. They were going to drive from L.A. to New York to join Benny Goodman, and they got married on the way
